messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] spike in 5xx + latency for model="mistral-8x" in us-west-2. RPM 1m avg = 4.9k -> 6.2k, 5xx rate 11% (5m). Pager: @alice-oncall @ben-sre :rotating_light:

alice-oncall: seeing it. high retry volume from a few customers too. thinking transient backend OOMs on the runtime nodes?

ben-sre: can you check node OOMs + recent deploys? tagging @carla-runtime for serving metrics and config.

carla-runtime: looking now. no deploys in the last 30m. heap OOMs on a subset of us-west-2 pods running mistral-8x quantized variant? logs show repeated KV cache miss thrash and high GPU mem alloc failures.

carla-runtime: metrics: GPU mem alloc errors spiked at 02:18 UTC, per-pod p95 latency increased from 120ms -> 450ms. Customer-facing error primarily 503/504.

alice-oncall: impact assessment: ACME-Payments (acct: acme-pay) and DataSift are pinned to mistral-8x. support pinging them.

dave-support: posted to customers: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx when using model mistral-8x in us-west-2. Short term mitigation in progress."

frank-pm: flagging high priority — ACME-Payments has live traffic. need ETA and mitigation that minimizes rollback risk.

carla-runtime: immediate mitigation suggestion: temporarily lower RPM/TMP for mistral-8x in us-west-2 and route new traffic to mistral-8x-quant-fallback (lower capacity but stable). also disable streaming chunked responses for that model to reduce resource churn. propose RPM -> 800 (global), TPM -> 12000, and enable routing rule.

ben-sre: +1 on targeted throttle. prefer per-model per-region change instead of global to limit customer impact. can we do a 15m window throttle while we triage?

alice-oncall: I'll take the throttle. handoff to ben in 20m if not resolved.

carla-runtime: applying change via internal quota API now. command:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/svc/quotas/update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${SRE_TOKEN}' \
  -d '{"model":"mistral-8x","region":"us-west-2","rpm":800,"tpm":12000,"reason":"live mitigation - high 5xx"}'
```

carla-runtime: response 200. new quota active. also pushed routing rule to split 70% -> mistral-8x-quant-fallback, 30% keep to main in us-west-2.

alice-oncall: verifying metrics after change.

deploy-bot: config-change: quota/update model=mistral-8x region=us-west-2 rpm=800 tpm=12000 by carla-runtime at 1789001290

carla-runtime: quick check: 1m RPM dropped from 6.2k -> 2.1k in 90s, 5xx rate down to 3.6% (from 11%). latency p95 trending down.

emily-cs: updated ACME-Payments and DataSift with mitigation ETA and asked if they can failover to other model families; ACME said they can briefly divert to mistral-8x-quant-fallback.

frank-pm: good. log the customer consent for postmortem notes.

ben-sre: triage next: reproduce mem-alloc on a staging group with same load. carla, can you capture core dumps / GPU logs?

carla-runtime: yes capturing and uploading to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1789001234/mistral8x. saved pod list and trace ids.

alice-oncall: handoff: ben, I'll drop off in 18m. current state: mitigation active (rpm=800/tpm=12k), 5xx -> 2-4%, routing to fallback enabled. users notified.

ben-sre: taking over. will coordinate with runtime + infra for deeper dive. plan: repro on canary cluster, try kernel-level allocator tuning, and if needed pin to a different kernel / rollback quantization change.

dave-support: customers asking about ETA. what should I tell them?

ben-sre: tell them: "Mitigation applied, error rates reduced significantly. Investigating root cause; next update in 30m or sooner if status changes."

carla-runtime: note for post-incident actions: add a canary that simulates KV-cache heavy sequences for quantized variants; create automatic circuit-breaker to reduce allocations before OOM.

frank-pm: please include cost/latency tradeoffs in the follow-up. ACME will want SLA credit guidance.

ben-sre: agreed. I'm leaving a 15m mitigation window on the quota change to avoid thrash; will extend if needed. will start a postmortem draft once we have logs. assigning follow-up owners: carla-runtime (root cause), ben-sre (postmortem), emily-cs (customer comms).

alice-oncall: thanks team. I'm available if escalation needed.

incident-bot: status update: incident 1789001234 mitigation applied at 1789001290; severity lowered to sev-2.

ben-sre: closing note: we should add a runbook entry for per-model region throttles and a checklist for pinned-customer notifications. I'll add to the runbook repo after triage.

carla-runtime: uploaded detailed logs and a short reproduction script to the incident folder.

emily-cs: customers acknowledged the update; ACME scheduled a brief maintenance window to test fallback tomorrow.

ben-sre: final: leaving the throttle in place until tomorrow 02:40 UTC or until we push a stable patch. will post progress to #postmortems.

alice-oncall: confirmed. handoff complete.
